Architecture and normal use: The phase machine drives flight, wait, bite, fight and landing. Cast by motion or touch practice, lift when the float dives, then follow the fight-specific rod and reel instructions.
Automated evidence: Seeded native and WASM regression: casts, late/early strikes, line tension, record awards and persistence.
Remaining on-device acceptance: Compare hook and rod response on an assembled device, including false triggers during motor bursts.

Architecture and normal use: 117 Thailand location recipes and four light periods share a compact procedural landscape. A stored Bangkok pond time can follow the clock; offline selection remains available.
Automated evidence: HTTP and native rendering tests cover 468 place/time combinations; hosted two-profile room test is separate from board sessions.
Remaining on-device acceptance: Verify final frame time and input latency at max animation, audio and connected load.

Architecture and normal use: QMI8658 motion and signed AS5600 readings drive rod and reel. Twelve virtual detents per turn feed an independent click mix. Prawn, ray and runner have distinct fights.
Automated evidence: Host wheel wrap, magnet dropout, direction reversal, click waveform and fish recovery tests.
Remaining on-device acceptance: Confirm real motor/reel and IMU readouts remain stable over full rotation and all haptic levels.

Architecture and normal use: The physical panel uses 480 × 320 logical landscape coordinates. The simulator projects the same coordinates onto the modeled LCD. The native touch grid audits nine positions.
Automated evidence: Panel mapping tests and browser routing, picker, zoom, orientation and actual touch event profiles.
Remaining on-device acceptance: 9/9 bare and assembled, powered by pack and USB. Record each coordinate and inspect edge preload.

Architecture and normal use: API v1 exposes raw IMU samples, scaled data, timestamps and validity; gyro power can be toggled for additional applications.
Automated evidence: Compiled native interface and known-pose gesture checks. Phone tests exercise phone sensors or injected traces.
Remaining on-device acceptance: Capture signed readings at rest, raised, moving and during rumble using production IMU.

Architecture and normal use: ES8311/I²S supplies music and bite cues; optional DRV2605L drives the ERM. On iPhone Safari fish patterns use sound and light. A user-tapped native switch can give a system tick.
Automated evidence: Browser PCM/speaker-check WAV, interruption recovery and supported haptic patterns; desktop WebKit check has no physical output device.
Remaining on-device acceptance: Hear and feel each motif, measure peak current and listen for audible buzz on actual hardware.

Architecture and normal use: Stable fish IDs keep the field book and personal-best records; purchases, refunds and saved rig settings use local persistence.
Automated evidence: Tests cover prior save migration, records, point accounting, refund and repeat play.
Remaining on-device acceptance: Cycle battery power after saving and interrupt writes during staged bench testing.

Architecture and normal use: Firmware supports local board sessions; the private HTTPS playtest uses separate hosted event rooms. RTC/NTP support Bangkok time.
Automated evidence: Hosted two-client scoring, session expiry and duplicate scoring regressions; compiled RTC paths.
Remaining on-device acceptance: Test two production units, offline rejoin, network loss and actual RTC holdover.

Architecture and normal use: USB recovery remains accessible. Owner-managed signed OTA packages bind model and increasing release number. Private keys stay outside this repository.
Automated evidence: Compiled image, partition offsets, image hashes and host validation artifacts. Native fault-injection acceptance remains open.
Remaining on-device acceptance: Perform interrupted update, rejected signature, wrong model, failed health check and recovery on actual board.

Architecture and normal use: Tap a target. Rest then lift for a branch, or lower and unwind 0.30 turns for a rock. Twelve separately illustrated finds can be reeled ashore according to habitat. Fixed branches and boulders remain snags.
Automated evidence: Seeded catch, contact and salvage regressions for the compiled native and WASM engine. All 468 place/time combinations covered.
Remaining on-device acceptance: Try each release motion on the physical rod. Measure gesture recognition during reel clicks and rumble.

Architecture and normal use: Mobile actors cross the fishing view while the water, shoreline and rod animate. Destination, time period and clock drive their movement.
Automated evidence: WASM motion probes across the destination and period matrix. Native rendering comparisons are recorded with the animation tests.
Remaining on-device acceptance: Check display throughput and missed encoder samples at peak gameplay load.

Architecture and normal use: The browser contains the complete illustrated field guide. The handheld loads the additional species portraits from a version-matched microSD card into PSRAM at startup. A filed catch retains its stable catalog ID.
Automated evidence: The browser renders every species and compares color pixels and silhouette hashes. A restored Labeo dyocheilus catch is filed and compared after reloading the journal.
Remaining on-device acceptance: Try a correct card, an absent card and an incompatible card on the target unit. Confirm the resident roster, the stored journal, cold-start time and memory with audio and radio enabled.
